acceptanceCriteria: A Claude Code or Codex notice for corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-deadline keeps its unchanged frame and code, then on following lines says in plain words that Corvint's check did not finish within the hook time limit, that this event got no Corvint context and that coding continues, names the likely causes (a very large uncommitted or staged change set, heavy machine load) and gives a concrete, read-only next step naming the project root (for example the exact JSON argv for git status). It claims no cause it did not observe.

The remediation text appears in every channel the notice already uses (systemMessage for Stop and other user-visible events, additionalContext where the event takes it), within the adapter output limit, and the stale-snapshot remediation (AHI-031/AHI-053) is unchanged.
A new AHI requirement records the wording rule, with tests for Stop, UserPromptSubmit and the Codex adapter; the requirement is accepted only after independent review.
body: Observed 2026-10-11 in a Claude Code session on /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint (Corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 456): the Stop hook showed only `Corvint FALLBACK degraded: corvint-event-rejected:dogfood-event-deadline; coding continues`. Cause, established by hand: the primary checkout had 4,599 dirty paths (3,523 staged) at load average ~40, so the dogfood event exceeded its 1600 ms bound (LCP-V0-008). The owner asked that the warning say what to do. The stale-snapshot case already appends a cause and the exact refresh argv (cmd/corvint/host_adapter.go snapshotRemediation, AHI-031/AHI-053); the plain deadline case appends nothing (claudeDegradedOutput, degradedAdapterOutput, codexDegraded). Expected: the deadline notice names likely causes and a read-only next step. Actual: only the code. Related but distinct: V1-0607 (investigate deadline cost), V1-1120 (Frontier Stop fails open on deadline), V1-0844.

completion.reason: Delivered by beamfall/corvint#823 (merged 2026-10-12T03:28:09Z): dogfood-event-deadline fallback names cause and a read-only next step (AHI-055 accepted after Codex round 2 PASS); evidence is the sha256 of the sealed CEM .corvint/changes/72aa8345830f743b278ef4e77c1c76ea258d1971.cem.json at origin/main.

title: hosts: dogfood-event-deadline fallback names only a code, with no cause or next step for the user
